verdict.rationale: OpenHands is fundamentally designed as an autonomous coding agent that runs in sandboxed environments (local/Docker/VM/cloud) and can execute natural-language tasks, implying it sets up its own working environment to act on a repo, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of automatic git clone + dependency install as a discrete guaranteed workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs/example showing the agent autonomously cloning a repo and installing dependencies end-to-end, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
